summary: Expose typed roster, conversation and example-data props in RedesignMilestone and Families while retaining authored story defaults; scope Retry recovery to its input, keep open conversations safe when roster rows disappear, and render empty Changes inputs safely

replay.detail: Presentation-only seam; no replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No wire schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Internal composition props replace the milestone state selector and module-level fixtures. Stories remain contract-fixture exemptions with their existing authored data and interactions; scenario conversion is separate.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or swap-back restrictions.
